    - heading "Understand Collinearity Test" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A collinearity test checks whether points lie on one straight line. In Collinearity Test, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Slope test: slope AB=slope BC. You can learn Collinearity Test by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Choose three points. Compare slopes or check whether the area of the triangle is zero. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, road alignment: Markers can be checked for one straight line. Watch out: Judging collinearity only by eye. Use slope or area checks."

    - heading "Synchronized tests" [level=3]
    - paragraph: All must agree for collinearity.
    - heading "Slope test (AB vs BC)" [level=4]
    - text: m
    - subscript: AB
    - text: = (y₂-y₁)/(x₂-x₁) and m
    - subscript: BC
    - text: = (y₃-y₂)/(x₃-x₂)
    - paragraph: Values
    - strong:
      - text: m
      - subscript: AB
      - text: = 0.375 m
      - subscript: BC
      - text: = 0.375
    - paragraph: Difference / direction test
    - strong:
      - text: directions agree
    - heading "Zero-area test (determinant)" [level=4]
    - generic: D = (x₂-x₁)(y₃-y₁) - (y₂-y₁)(x₃-x₁)
    - paragraph: Value
    - strong:
      - text: D = 0
    - generic: Twice the signed area of triangle ABC
    - heading "Vector (cross product) test in 2D" [level=4]
    - generic: AB × AC = (x₂-x₁)(y₃-y₁) - (y₂-y₁)(x₃-x₁)
    - paragraph: Value
    - strong:
      - text: AB × AC = 0
    - generic: "Result: Collinear"
    - paragraph: All exact tests agree.
  - article:
    - heading "⌁ Rule / Formula" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Three points A(x₁,y₁), B(x₂,y₂), C(x₃,y₃) are collinear if any of the following is true:"
    - list:
      - listitem: "Slope test: directions AB and BC agree."
      - listitem: "Determinant test: D = 0."
      - listitem: "Vector test: AB × AC = 0."
  - article:
    - heading "▣ Worked example (correct)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Are A(-2,1), B(1,3), C(4,5) collinear?
    - text: m
    - subscript: AB
    - text: = 2/3, m
    - subscript: BC
    - text: = 2/3
    - text: D = 3·4 - 2·6 = 0
    - text: AB × AC = 0
    - generic: All zero ⇒ Collinear.
  - article:
    - heading "Common misconception" [level=2]:
      - text: Common misconception
    - text: Equal slopes are not always enough.
    - paragraph:
